column8: Mon 16 Nov: store; twin of row 2 (the trade's binding reference is a simulation made before the run), and row 2 has ISO's stronger wording; as a guard it keeps the word proof off the 2031 statement.

Mon 16 Nov: store, or one bridge clause in 3c beside Q74-002; ISO's own word for a contract proof's job is predicting, so the 2031 statement is never a proof; the contrast makes the same point as row 4, which is stronger; carries row 1.
Mon 16 Nov: store only; the colour-difference limits are background for the never-a-tolerance verdict and mean nothing to a finance reader; row 4 carries the point.

Mon 16 Nov: 3c, the clearest print-world reason the report says certain and never tolerance or confidence interval; 200,000 paths, 1,770 and 585 windows match NUMBERS 4; date it to ISO 12647-2:2004 with Amd 1:2007 (the 2013 edition not read, so S 4), say up to about a third may fall outside, one clause beside Q74-002 (Neyman) and Q74-016, never a second turn in 3c; carries row 24.

Mon 16 Nov: the technical form of row 26 (the reference changes once in a run); each end's own date is CONCEIT 5b rank 2; both press references carry an error allowance and Laura's ends carry none after their dates, so store only.

Mon 16 Nov: 3b-3c, a fresh angle (printing trades some certainty for cost, the plan trades size for certainty); $33,150 matches NUMBERS 4, but drop the $5,300 per $5,000 from this turn (8o's trade is stated top against what she keeps, size for size, not size for certainty; V2.2 3b carries it); a draft standard's wording, so cite it as ISO/DIS.

Mon 16 Nov: 3d at most, as plain prose; drop the contract-proof label, which the card's own claim 1 verdict forbids (a proof is a prediction, so it would call the statement provisional); the plain point, each stated figure names its Treasuries and its date, is Q79-018's rule and CONCEIT 5b rank 2; Fogra read on a mirror, so S 4.
Mon 16 Nov: twin of Q79-018 (every figure carries its kind, owned on a date or modelled), as the card says; a writers' rule, not a turn; never in tables (V2.4 guard 4).

Mon 16 Nov: store; precision on the wrong basis is a good line beside AHA row 7, but it leans on proof again and on Keel's own translation of a printer's sales page (English UNVERIFIED), so S 3; Q79-013 does the 3c job.
Mon 16 Nov: twin of V2.2 3c's dot gain (Q47 Part B row 7: the reference set inside what the process can deliver) and of golf Q79-024, as the card says; adds no turn.

Mon 16 Nov: twin of V2.2 3.0's certainty has dates (Q47 Part B row 15) and CONCEIT 5b rank 2, each line has its own inking date, as the card says; the dates check (Jan 2027, Jan 2028, the move, Dec 2032).

Mon 16 Nov: store, the source text behind rows 13 and 19; the two-way, billed allowance is the contrast to V2.2 3b's ink only goes one way; three printers' copies of the 1994 customs agree but PIA's own page was not found, so S 4; carries row 16.

Mon 16 Nov: 3c, an alternative margin turn to V2.2's dot gain or trim (one of them, chosen by a fresh reader, never stacked): a guaranteed count costs a doubled allowance; $123,476, $115,000 and $8,476 match NUMBERS 4 and 8k (8k: paid 15 Dec 2032; a register figure, not Keel arithmetic), and about 7% is right Keel arithmetic (7.4%); say about $8,500 as V2.2 does, central only (house 1-in-20 $4,669-$11,634); quote the 1985 doubling, dated, since the two copies differ on the trigger; never the word overrun (row 20); carries row 14.
Mon 16 Nov: the worked example of row 13 (60,000 rather than 55,000 on a 50,000 run), from a practitioner's newsletter; one number for row 13's set-up at most.

Mon 16 Nov: store only; it breaks on 3a's own point: spoiled sheets are destroyed while most of the extra Treasuries come back ($35,894 and about $45,500 in 2033 money match NUMBERS 4); V2.2 3a's reserve against returns fits and stays.
Mon 16 Nov: the UK form of row 12's two-way custom, smaller for long runs; 0.75% and about 1 house path in 17 match NUMBERS 4; adds nothing a part needs.

Mon 16 Nov: the same buyer's rule as row 18 (no unders), from forum posts, so S 3; its half about overs having no value to buyers is Q25-001's finding (exceeding a promise buys no credit), which is stronger.

Mon 16 Nov: 3d store; a public buyer's written rule that unders are not accepted and that its terms beat trade custom; never claim what co-sponsors' terms say (outside the case); Q67-043 and Q25-001 do the 3d job; carries row 17.

Mon 16 Nov: 3b-3c, the cleanest plain shape of the top (run extra to be safe, deliver the exact count, set the surplus aside); in this mapping Laura is the printer, so the recorded disanalogy (who keeps the surplus) is not one, and it mends trim's break (bleed is cut away and lost, CONCEIT s4); the same slot as row 13 and dot gain, one only; a franchise printer's undated page, so S 4; never the word overrun.
Mon 16 Nov: writers' rule, binding if any of rows 12-19 is used; IPS l.15's building costs that overrun checked in the FINAL; one word must not mean money short in 3b and money left over in 3c.

Mon 16 Nov: twin of V2.2's non-photo blue (Q47 Part B row 9: models shown to the judges, never stated to co-sponsors), as the card says; a liability disclaimer reads defensive where the report discloses.

Mon 16 Nov: twin of Q79-013 (the range is a rule and today's figures a reading of it), which is stronger, as the card says; a quote that may be changed also hints a stated figure can be re-quoted, which after the move it cannot.

Mon 16 Nov: 3e store; force majeure lists are ordinary contract wording (R 2) and excuse delays, while the two reasons are exits for when the plan cannot be carried out; 31 Mar 2028, five business days and IPS l.17 check; never imply the two reasons excuse Laura.
Mon 16 Nov: twin of row 4 (the trade expects the run to miss its proof a little), which gives the measured 68%; the customs' acceptable variation is the weaker form.
Mon 16 Nov: a definition only, background for row 26; no use of its own.

Mon 16 Nov: 3c or 3e, answers what the 7.5% means after 2031 (it no longer measures the top, only her flexibility; NUMBERS 4 and 8p check); competes with Q79-013 and V2.2's drying ink for 3c's one turn, so say it plainly unless a fresh reader picks it; proof and press-sheet words are a second vocabulary, and the original must never be the IPS (V2.4 guard 3); carries rows 5 and 25.
Mon 16 Nov: 3e, a plain outside source for V2.2 3e's line that after the inking dates only fund events and the paper are watched; the GPO quote is in the card; not a turn (claim 3's verdict).
Mon 16 Nov: store; Table 3's dates are already set in advance, and pressroom sampling is for drift while Laura's checks are for named events, as the card says.

Mon 16 Nov: twin of V2.2 3e's a stroke is not retouched (Q47 Part B row 12: watching is not re-deciding; a fall is not a reason, IPS l.17); a press check adjusts colour, which reads as adjusting the plan.

Mon 16 Nov: a verdict row: registration marks stay (V2.2 3e) and the press check stays out, for three sound reasons (a second image for one job, the IPS as proof under guard 3, IPS l.17); kept findable so the press check is not proposed again.
Mon 16 Nov: the set-up clause for row 32 (in printing, whoever signs the proof carries the error); case l.114's credibility line checked exact; carried by row 32.

Mon 16 Nov: 3d, the card's best turn (sign OK FOR COLOR, never OK TO PRINT): the scope of a signature, the two ends she owns and never her flexibility or a forecast; one turn per part, so it replaces the seal (Q47 Part B row 14) rather than stacking; tell it as scope, not the principle again (AHA rows 4 and 8: its one home is 3.0); the signature maps to her statement, never to ink (card Q42's signed sense); in the team's sentence before her words (V2.4 guard 4); carries rows 31 and 33.
Mon 16 Nov: a detail of row 32, as the card says; dating every ink sentence is CONCEIT 5b rank 2 already.

Mon 16 Nov: twin of V2.2 3d's seal, stamped when the work is finished (Q47 Part B row 14), and of the drying ink: she names the range only after the move; $17,184 to $8,922 matches NUMBERS 8p's flat-then-fall row; keep the card's fix, hers to answer for, never hers to keep, for the contribution.

Mon 16 Nov: refused as a turn, as the card finds: stet lives on a proof, so it calls the owned range provisional, and pointed at the plan it makes the IPS a proof (V2.4 guard 3); the dictionary facts are true.

Mon 16 Nov: store only; a third craft field (colour management) for one clause in 2.2, and calibrate suggests a plan tuned over time; TNA l.15's net asset value, as opposed to a promise of par checked exact.
Mon 16 Nov: twin of V2.2 3c's dot gain and safe area (Q47 Part B rows 7-8: the reference set inside what the process can deliver), as the card says; $8,476 matches NUMBERS 4.
